title: Wall Street Journal op-ed and David Spergel's dismissal
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Wall Street Journal op-ed and David Spergel's dismissal, about 2023-2025 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: A friend of mine was planning an op-ed with a former cabinet member in the US.
I also went to the Wall Street Journal and I advocated for uh an article to be published
tellings.difference: Names the co-author as a former Secretary of Defense and stresses that the WSJ rejected it, without mentioning Spergel.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Jesse pushing for a Wall Street Journal op-ed co-written with a former cabinet member that the paper did not run.
